hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in git\ commit*) if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'APP-[0-9]+:'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit message must start with APP-{N}: prefix (Linear issue required)"}}'; exit 0; fi; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main); if [ "$branch" != "main" ] && ! echo "$branch" | grep -qE '^feat/app-[0-9]+-'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Branch name must match feat/app-{N}-* pattern (Linear issue required)"}}'; exit 0; fi;; git\ checkout\ -b*|git\ branch\ [!-]*) name=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/git (checkout -b|branch) //; s/ .*//'); if ! echo "$name" | grep -qE '^feat/app-[0-9]+-'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Branch name must match feat/app-{N}-* pattern (Linear issue required)"}}'; exit 0; fi;; esac; }

hooks.prompt: Check if this Bash command is a git commit or creates a new branch (git checkout -b, git branch <name>, git switch -c). If it is a git commit: verify the commit message starts with 'APP-{N}: ' where N is a number (Linear issue reference). If it creates a new branch: verify the branch name matches 'feat/app-{N}-*' pattern. If the command is not related to git commits or branch creation, ALLOW it. If it violates the convention, BLOCK it with an explanation of the correct format. Command: $ARGUMENTS
